facts.business: Welspun Corp Limited manufactures line pipes, ductile iron pipes, stainless steel bars, pipes & tubes, water storage tanks & plastic pipes, and TMT rebars.

capacity_or_capex.item: Property, plant and equipment (net of capital advances)

facts.related_party_note: Corporate guarantees given by the company for loans of subsidiaries and joint ventures: Rs. 4,664.33 crore (March 31, 2026); Loan/liabilities outstanding against these guarantees aggregate to Rs. 1,678.16 crore (March 31, 2026).
